events.evidence: An oil terminal in Feodosia, the largest oil facility in Russian-occupied Crimea, catches fire following an overnight drone attack by Ukrainian forces
Hamas, Hezbollah, and the Houthis launch rockets and missiles towards Tel Aviv, Haifa, and Tiberias, Israel
Hurricane Milton intensifies into a Category 5 hurricane with a minimum central pressure of 897 millibars

label.note: Ukraine energy/port strikes and Israel rocket attacks alongside Category 5 Milton raise geopolitical and disaster risk appetite.
